tools.name: design_show
tools.description: For any UI, screen, mockup or visual design in this Chat, subagents included: use this, not HTML or image files, so it lands on the Chat's Designs canvas, where the user watches, reviews and chooses. Create an editable design from a document of named layers, with frames, text, shapes, icons, images, layout and color tokens. The user can edit layers on desktop. On phone they review and choose designs, and request changes through Chat. The document sets the screen size (390 by 844 for a phone). Read the bundled design skill ($BUNDLED_SKILLS/design/SKILL.md) for the document format. A new id creates a design; revising an existing id requires expectedVersion from design_read, so the user's changes are preserved. Prefer design_apply for small revisions. Use a different id for each variant, in the same group; to revise a design, keep its id. For a variant of a saved design, send from (its id and version) and only the operations that differ, instead of a whole document: Milagre copies it and applies them. When the user names another design tool, use that tool instead. The result includes the rendered design as an image and layout warnings; check both before replying.

tools.name: design_read
tools.description: Read a structured design document and its layer ids, with the latest version unless you name one. Read before editing and send its version as expectedVersion to design_apply or design_show. User edits also create versions.

tools.name: design_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a saved design without creating a version. Returns its image, computed layer bounds, contrast coverage and preview limitations. Use this when taking over from another model or reviewing user edits. nodeId crops the image to a visible layer; diagnostics still cover the whole screen.

tools.name: design_validate
tools.description: Preflight a proposed document, or a batch against a saved design and expectedVersion, without saving. Optional intent is enforced exactly as on design_apply. Returns validation errors with field paths, measured layout shortages, candidate repair operations (validate before applying) and the resulting document. Use before a complex edit. Send document OR id, expectedVersion and operations.

tools.name: design_apply
tools.description: Revise a design on this Chat's Designs canvas, keeping its id; any agent or subagent changing a design uses this (or design_show with expectedVersion), never a separate file. Edit it with one atomic batch of layer operations: update properties, insert a layer, or delete a layer and its descendants. To replace the whole document, use design_show with its id and expectedVersion. Use stable layer ids. expectedVersion must match the latest version read; a conflict changes nothing, so read again and reapply the intended edits. Optional intent enforces text-only preservation or fit-text within declared textIds/layoutIds. Rejected intent saves nothing. One successful batch creates one immutable version and shows its design card.

tools.name: design_export
tools.description: Export an editable design version as its source JSON document or a standalone SVG. The SVG names its fonts without embedding them. Returns the filename, MIME type and file content. Save the content to a file when the user requests a downloadable export.

tools.name: design_delete
tools.description: Delete a design and every version of it from this Chat, with the comments on it. Only when the user asks to delete it, for example the variants they did not choose. Its cards in the Chat stay but no longer open it, and its id can't be used again.

tools.name: artifact_comments
tools.description: List the comments the user left on this Chat's designs and HTML artifacts, the open ones unless you ask for all. Each has an id, its original design version, optional nodeId identifying its layer, where on it the user pinned it (x and y as fractions of the design's screen) and its text. Comments remain available after their old preview is pruned. Read the latest design before editing the named layer; the pin coordinates describe the original version, not the current layout.

tools.name: artifact_resolve_comment
tools.description: Mark one of the user's comments on a design or HTML artifact resolved once you have addressed it (usually after showing a revised version), with a short note on what you changed. The pin disappears from the canvas; the comment and your note remain in Chat history. The comment's id is in the user's message, or from artifact_comments.

tools.name: artifact_show
tools.description: Create or replace this Chat's one live HTML artifact page explaining a topic, report or interactive page. Edits update that same page in place; there are no variants or browsable versions. Use design_show for UI screens, mockups and visual design work. HTML artifacts stay available when Designs is off. For a diagram, put Mermaid text in <pre class="mermaid">: Milagre draws it, no script needed. Send html for one page, or tabs to split it into tabs Milagre draws above it; a tab sent without html keeps the HTML it has, so you can change one tab and resend only that one. For photos, videos or any other file, save it in the Chat's Worktree, attach it in assets by name and absolute path, and use it in the HTML as assets/<name>; Milagre copies it, and the page keeps it while its HTML mentions it.

tools.name: artifact_list
tools.description: Read the summary of this Chat's one live explanatory HTML artifact page. Structured designs use design_list.

tools.name: design_kit_read
tools.description: Read this Project's shared visual kit (default id project), latest or a pinned version. Read before designing or taking over another model. Returns colors, text styles, spacing, radii, component templates and references. null means no kit has been established. Pass the returned snapshot as document.kit; existing screens keep their pinned version.

tools.name: design_kit_save
tools.description: Create or revise this Project's shared visual kit. Use the app's existing identity and confirmed decisions. expectedVersion is 0 for a new kit, otherwise read the latest first. Saves an immutable version without changing existing designs. To adopt it on a screen, explicitly apply a document patch with the returned kit snapshot and inspect the result. Components are ordinary layer arrays, each with one main frame whose id matches its map key.

tools.name: design_list
tools.description: List the structured designs in the Chat granted to this local connection.
